Do not merge ACES Delta, LLC with Advanced Clean Energy Storage I, LLC; the latter is the linked first project company.

Record Haddington Energy Partners III as a former indirect platform owner through Magnum and distinguish it from Haddington ESP I's continuing managed project-construction equity.
Do not treat Chevron's terminated 2021 proposal as a pending transaction.
releaseRequirement: Correct the existing ACES Delta record: retain one canonical platform, remove the four institutional LPs as direct owners, add Chevron/Magnum and Mitsubishi as current platform owners, preserve Haddington Energy Partners III as former indirect owner, and describe Haddington ESP I only as current managed ACES I construction equity with its instrument and percentage undisclosed.
